text:
pagerduty: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service="inference-api-us-east1" reason="DB connection saturation / pgbouncer accept queue" priority=P1. Routing to #eng-oncall

incident-bot: Page created, escalation policy=oncall-db. Primary: @maria, Secondary: @alex. Incident ID: INC-2024-1367

maria: taking this. i see a spike in active DB connections + pgbouncer accept queue filling. starting investigation.

alex: pinged, standing by. any customer impact seen yet?

maria: yes — error-rate on /v1/generate up ~11% over last 5m. 504s and occasional 502 from proxy. suspect backlog at pgbouncer -> DB.

infra-bot: Metric snippet: pgbouncer_us-east1.active_clients=4820, pgbouncer_us-east1.max_clients=5000, pgbouncer_us-east1.accept_queue=780, pg-master-us-east1.active_connections=5180, pg-master-us-east1.max_connections=5500. Redis timeouts trending up too (rt > 200ms).

alex: ok, two things to triage in parallel: 1) reduce connection pressure (limit burst traffic / enable read-only fallback) 2) mitigate long queries / restart pgbouncer if needed.

maria: running quick top queries on pg to find long running:
```
SELECT pid, state, query, now() - pg_stat_activity.query_start AS dur
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state = 'active'
ORDER BY dur DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

maria: found several old COPY/large-join jobs from internal-backfill process. New deploy kicked off backfills unintentionally. killing the top offenders now (`SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) WHERE dur > interval '2 minutes'`).

alex: killed the backfill PIDs. accept_queue dropped to ~200 after terminations. error-rate started to come down to ~6%. good sign.

pagerduty: Acknowledged by maria (oncall).

maria: still seeing periodic spikes. pgbouncer process memory also climbing. going to rotate pgbouncer pool on the pooler hosts, one at a time (staggered) to avoid total outage. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/db/pgbouncer-rotate

infra-bot: executing restart plan on pgbouncer-us-east1-az-a -> sudo systemctl restart pgbouncer && wait 45s healthcheck.

infra-bot: restart completed on az-a, health checks green. accept_queue=30. restarting az-b now.

maria: after pool restarts, accept_queue normal ~<20, active_clients ~1800. but noticed client retry storm from some SDK versions hitting us aggressively after the short restarts. throttling edge for inference/generate to 20rps per-token for non-enterprise clients.

alex: did we identify root cause? i.e., why pgbouncer hit capacity?

maria: root cause combo: 1) a runaway backfill job (internal infra job) created many long transactions holding connections; 2) Redis latency for key lookups increased due to a cold node during failover, which caused application workers to block waiting for cache -> more DB connections accumulated.

infra-bot: redis-us-east1 node-3 experienced GC spike and lagged replication, resulted in timeouts ~45s window. error logs: `MOVED` spikes + `timeout` in client logs.

sre: noted customers impacted: 3 enterprise tenants have elevated 5xxs (billing, search-related inference). Customer success alerted for those accounts. no broad data loss.

maria: mitigation summary so far:
- terminated runaway backfill transactions
- rotated pgbouncer poolers across azs (staggered)
- throttled non-enterprise edge traffic to relieve burst
- kicked a cache node replace (redis node-3) and promoted replica

alex: recommend follow-ups: increase pgbouncer max_clients on short-term, add circuit breaker on long-tail cache ops, and pin internal backfill jobs to a maintenance window with rate limits. also add monitoring alert when accept_queue > 200 for 2m.

maria: agree. i'll open followup tickets. i also want to handoff to night oncall @jordana with a short summary and ask SRE to run a controlled scale test.

maria: Handoff summary for @jordana:
- current status: stable, accept_queue ~10, error-rate ~1.2% (almost baseline)
- actions taken: killed backfill, rotated pgbouncer pools, throttled edge, replaced redis node-3
- followups: increase pgbouncer headroom, add accept_queue alert, implement cache op circuit breaker, audit internal backfill schedules
- customers to watch: tenant-alpha, tenant-beta, tenant-gamma (CS notified)

jordana: taking handoff. i will monitor metrics for the next 2h and keep PD un-acked until stable for 30m. added myself to incident timeline. thanks for quick response. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: Incident INC-2024-1367 status changed to 'stabilized' by jordana. will move to post-incident review after followups created.

sre: created followup ticket RW-5482: "pgbouncer headroom + accept_queue alert + backfill rate limit" assigned to infra team.

maria: leaving notes in the runbook and toggling the throttles off once we confirm stable. great teamwork. closing the page once oncall okays.

jordana: thanks all — i'll update the incident thread if anything regresses. handing back to infra for long-term fixes. :lock:
